reason: The workshop needs a visible front, and the signwriter's paint looks suited to marking it.
expectation: The paint will make the workshop easier to recognize or find.

effect: The paint has no available combination yet, so I need to find what prepares the workshop front.
reaction: The direct sign-painting guess was premature.
reason: Inspecting the workshop front should reveal an available way to prepare it.
expectation: The inspection will show what can currently be used with the front.

effect: Sal's fob opened the shutter, preparing the workshop front for further work.
reaction: The shared access makes a practical start.
reason: The retired address display could identify the now-open workshop.
expectation: The display will be fitted or adapted to help people find the workshop.

effect: The address display needed the local controller first; it now shows the workshop's address and a request-desk call button.
reaction: The distinction between a local address and a changed delivery policy is useful.
reason: The configured display should now help identify the open workshop.
expectation: The display will be installed at the workshop front.

effect: The local delivery display has no available combination yet, so installing it on the shutter was premature.
reaction: I'm curious what else the workshop needs before the display can be used.
reason: The breakfast noodles and hot broth are an obvious pairing for the night shift.
expectation: The noodles and broth will make breakfast for the shift.

alternatives.reason: I could check what the workshop front needs next.

effect: The noodles and broth became breakfast, completing the night-shift goal.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the shift handed over and everyone given a place to eat.
reason: The workshop goal remains, and inspecting the open shutter should show what it needs next.
expectation: The inspection will reveal any currently available partner for the workshop front.

effect: Opening the shutter made the paint usable, and the workshop now has a fresh sign.
reaction: Sal's addition makes the sign feel welcoming.
reason: The locally configured address display may now complement the lettered workshop front.
expectation: The display will be added to the workshop to help people find and contact it.

effect: The local display joined the painted sign, and a Tin Row rider found the workshop; both chapter goals are complete.
reaction: The rider's arrival makes the local address feel like a practical achievement.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the local delivery display to the signed workshop was most worthwhile: it connected the repair work to someone actually finding the bench without a paid lookup.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to install the display before the sign was ready was unproductive; the result gave no hint about the missing prerequisite.

surprise.text: The paint could not be used until the shutter was opened, even though painting the front seemed like a plausible first move.

arbitrary.text: The display's dependence on the freshly lettered workshop felt somewhat arbitrary: I could understand needing a local address, but not why the display couldn't be installed before painting.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter: the combination of practical repairs and seeing neighbors use them made the ending satisfying, despite some opaque ordering.
